verdict.rationale: mise is a local CLI for dev tools, env vars and tasks. It has no hosted API or account system to issue API credentials from, and the probe found no OpenAPI surface, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a category error for this product type. Its local MCP server, MISE_SAFE and sandboxing settings are adjacent execution controls, not credential issuance, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
